chunks: So that none may err against the scales,

key_terms.الْمِيزَانِ: The scales, representing justice, measurement, and balance in trade and deeds

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command regarding the scales and measurement?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often interpreted not merely as a commercial injunction but as a cosmic mandate for balance (mizan) in all aspects of life, reflecting the divine attribute of Adl (Justice). Scholars emphasize that 'transgression' here implies both quantitative cheating in trade and qualitative deviation from moral equilibrium, linking economic integrity to spiritual health. This command serves as a practical application of the broader Quranic theme of maintaining the scales of justice established by Allah.
